Card Sharks.name: Card Sharks
Card Sharks.summary: Card Sharks is a cancelled card game that was in development in 2000 by Bonsai Entertainment for the Game Boy Color.

Hello Kitty no Magical Museum.name: Hello Kitty no Magical Museum
Hello Kitty no Magical Museum.summary: Hello Kitty no Magical Museum is a Puzzle game, developed by Atelier Double and published by Imagineer, which was released in Japan in 1999.

Koto Battle - Tengai no Moribito.name: Koto Battle: Tengai no Moribito
Koto Battle - Tengai no Moribito.summary: The first game developed by AlphaDream, it was released on the Game Boy Color in Japan only.

Magical Tetris Challenge.name: Magical Tetris Challenge
Magical Tetris Challenge.summary: The Game Boy Color port of Magical Tetris Challenge.

McDonald's Monogatari - Honobono Tenchou.name: McDonald's Monogatari: Honobono Tenchou Ikusei Game
McDonald's Monogatari - Honobono Tenchou.summary: A promotional tie-in game in which the player takes the role of a McDonald's restaurant worker, preparing food and working the cash register in a collection of mini-games.

Pocket Bowling.name: Pocket Bowling
Pocket Bowling.summary: Pocket Bowling for the Game Boy Color brings the popular blue collar sport to the tips of your fingers (and thumbs). You can choose from six bowlers, including a secret android character who appears only after you reach a certain level. Each bowler is rated on power and technique and uses a different weight of bowling ball. Apparently, all the bowlers are ambidextrous because each one can bowl right- or left-handed.

Silent Hill 2 - Born From a Wish.name: Silent Hill 2: Born From A Wish Demake
Silent Hill 2 - Born From a Wish.summary:
The short project I started Born from a Wish scenario was added to the download. I started working on it last year but found it needs an overhaul to melee combat.

Notably the "puzzle" will be solved by collecting all the metal plates then reading Amy Baldwin's stone in the fireplace.

There's a couple more clickable descriptions that are missing also missing is the event when Ernest opens the fireplace board, and the flashback audio of what happens to Amy...
